brainlife.desc: Power spectral density of MEG/EEG as a TSV table (channels x frequencies), per channel type, or summary values derived from it.
brainlife.name: neuro/meeg/psd

original.desc: Power spectral densities of MEG/EEG signals

file_descs.psd: Rows correspond to channels and columns to the frequencies.

brainlife.readme:
Dimensions: channels x freqs

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.meeg.psd.json

files.desc: Rows correspond to channels and columns to the frequencies.

identifying_risks: Individual M/EEG spectra can act as a neural fingerprint.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level derivative; step 4 applies if used for identification.
sharing_cautions: Share participant-level spectra only under a controlled agreement.
tier_conditions: Tier 4 if used as a spectral fingerprint to identify or profile individuals.

inputs_of.name: Find frequency peak of PSD data
inputs_of.purpose: per-channel peak frequency within a band

intended_use: Spectral summaries: band power, peak frequency, channel averages.
not_suitable_for: Mixing channel types (grad, mag, eeg) in one analysis; check tags.
Tables of peak frequency or mean amplitude, also stored here; check tags.

outputs_of.name: Find frequency peak of PSD data
outputs_of.purpose: per-channel peak frequency within a band

outputs_of.name: PSD of epoched data
outputs_of.purpose: multitaper PSD of epochs per channel type

outputs_of.name: PSD of raw data
outputs_of.purpose: Welch PSD per channel type from raw data
